target_customer: Amazon FBA sellers and brands that spend on Amazon advertising
problem: Amazon sellers must manage advertising bids and inventory across many products by hand, which wastes ad spend and time.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscriptions plus managed ad optimization services
product_category: Amazon seller growth automation and ads optimization

founders.name: Christopher Compean
prior_employers: Several Boston startups in incubator, ed-tech and video advertising
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; Mayan is his first venture.

founders.name: Javier Garcia
previous_startups: Describes himself as a 4x founder; companies not named on YC page

competitors.name: Teikametrics
competitors.what: Amazon advertising and marketplace optimization software
competitors.funding_then: 10M Series A in Oct 2018 and a further 15M reported Feb 2020

competitors.name: Perpetua
competitors.funding_then: CB Insights lists a round dated April 2021, details unverified

technical_complexity.rationale: Bid and inventory automation on the Amazon Ads API is standard data engineering with some modelling, built by MIT data scientists.

defensibility.rationale: Several established tools sold the same ad automation and sellers can switch vendors; the edge was execution and managed service.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Amazon kept expanding native ad tools but no source shows it absorbing the wedge; the company was still operating as of the sources found.

market_need_then: Amazon third party selling and ad spend grew quickly in 2020 and 2021, and the company reports customers gaining ad sales, though those figures are self-reported.

identity.voice_and_tone: Seller-to-seller: staffed by Amazon sellers, built by MIT scientists

branding.brand_signature: Positioning as the AI platform created by MIT scientists and staffed by Amazon sellers

brand_strength.rationale: Only a company tagline and G2 and directory listings surfaced; no press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Mayan raised a seed round after YC W21 and a 5M Series A led by Bright Pixel in March 2023, and still operates with a team of 14 on the YC page. It sells ad optimization to Amazon sellers in a crowded category with funded rivals. No exit or shutdown was found, so it looks like a steady but modest growth company; reported customer results are self-reported.
notes: Seed date not stated in the sources opened; an aggregator URL hints March 2022 but this is unverified. Search snippets say there were four MIT co-founders but only Compean and Garcia are named on the YC page, so only those two are recorded. Aggregators disagree on investors (one adds Basecamp Fund). Perpetua funding detail comes from one aggregator and is unverified. Outcome search found no news about the company.
